drill: Gate G6 Disaster Recovery & High-Availability Validation Drill (PE-007)

checks.name: Primary PostgreSQL WAL streaming + archiving configured
checks.detail: postgres-prod: wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders=10, archive_mode=on, synchronous_standby_names=unset (asynchronous: RPO > 0 on primary loss)

checks.name: DR warm standby declared as a streaming replica
checks.detail: postgres-dr: primary_conninfo set, standby bootstrap declared, healthcheck asserts recovery mode

checks.name: Kafka KRaft quorum survives one broker loss
checks.detail: 3 brokers, 3 KRaft controllers, 3 quorum voters; replication factor and min ISR tolerate one broker loss

checks.name: Kafka broker healthchecks can report an unhealthy broker
Kafka partition leader failover with zero message loss
checks.detail: requires the asset-ml Kafka cluster running and a broker kill with produce/consume accounting; this tool never stops a broker

checks.name: ML Gateway stateless worker failover
checks.detail: requires running ml-gateway workers and a worker kill; not exercised

checks.name: Z4 storage integrity & custody chain
checks.detail: requires the Z4 Bangladesh-resident DR site; not reachable from a workstation

checks.name: RPO <= 900 s (data loss at failover)
checks.detail: requires a running primary + DR standby and an executed failover; this tool never stops, fences or promotes a database

checks.name: RTO <= 1800 s (failure to traffic restored)
checks.detail: requires a running primary + DR standby and an executed failover; this tool never stops, fences or promotes a database

checks.name: Failback & cluster normalisation
checks.detail: requires a running primary + DR standby and an executed failover; this tool never stops, fences or promotes a database
